transformer.note: multi_winding rows require matching transformer_winding and transformer_impedance tables

transformer_winding.note: Use the exact schema emitted by import_dss; winding identity, connection, tap and ratings must match transformer and impedance rows.

transformer_impedance.note: Use the exact schema emitted by import_dss; rows describe pairwise winding short-circuit impedances.

reactor.note: Multiple electrical forms are supported; prefer import_dss output or consult psa/src/dsa/parse/reactor.rs before hand-authoring.

spectrum.constraint: h, mag_pct and angle_deg lists have equal length

xy_curve.shape: long table; one point per row

storage.note: RSDss import_dss currently returns this frame empty

constraints: one row when result is present
result is a comma-separated list without empty, unknown or duplicate names

load_shape.shape: long table; one sample per row

relay.note: Additional columns depend on relay type; consult relay_frame and the protection parser.

constraints: weight is finite and greater than zero
power_flow and current_magnitude require bus_from and bus_to
random modes require an empty table
scenario values are positive and contiguous from 1
m1_replay has exactly one value for every load and scenario
name is unique ignoring ASCII case
all currents are finite and non-negative
primary and backup differ ignoring ASCII case
real and imaginary lists are paired, non-empty, equal length and finite
standard-deviation lists are positive and match their phasor lengths
covariance and standard-deviation columns are mutually exclusive
covariance is a positive-definite flattened square matrix in current-re,current-im,voltage-re,voltage-im residual order
a switch name occurs at most once within a hypothesis ignoring ASCII case
a line name occurs at most once within a hypothesis ignoring ASCII case

dynamic_event.constraint: Required optional columns depend on kind; see dataframe_schema_reference.md.

fault.note: One row per independent fault case. Phasor and sequence columns are list<f64>; residual columns are scalar f64.

qsts_time_metadata.applies_to: Every per-step QSTS result frame, including state frames.

execution_plan_epoch_metadata.applies_to: Every DSS execution-plan result frame; trailing events after the final Solve contain null epoch metadata.
